title: The UI's HTTP surface is resource routes that return HTML; there is no RPC gateway

One interaction registry; the UI, the SDK and ACP are three ways to answer it

Python and TypeScript consumers get thin clients generated from one protocol schema, and the Go binary ships in the Python wheel
ACP stays an automation-only agent on stdio, built on a Go ACP library behind our own interface
MCP uses the official Go SDK in both roles; the host owns the child process
The plugin protocol is bidirectional NDJSON JSON-RPC 2.0 on the plugin's stdin and stdout
Web authentication keeps upstream's model: source check, then a signed cookie from a launch token, then an access check
